## Verified Configuration

**✓ Fixed – Fee Calculation (src/fees.js)**  
Removed the staging-specific `Math.round()` path. Staging now uses the same banker's rounding logic as production (`Math.floor()` + banker's adjustment), ensuring staging actually exercises production's fee calculation.

**✓ Preserved – Email Suppression (src/mailer.js)**  
Emails remain suppressed in staging and dev environments while production sends receipts normally. This legitimate staging need is maintained.

**✓ Preserved – Hardware Key Bypass (src/auth.js)**  
Second factor authentication remains skipped in staging while required in production. Staging accounts without hardware keys can still run.

Staging will now detect fee calculation discrepancies with production, closing the blind spot that allowed them to diverge undetected.
